autores: Ihsan Erdem Kayral, A. Jeribi, S. Loukil
resumo: Our investigation strives to unearth the best portfolio hedging strategy for the G7 stock indices through Bitcoin and gold using daily data relevant to the period 2 January 2016 to 5 January 2023. resumo: In this paper we predict Bitcoin movements by utilizing a machine-learning framework.
